explication: The product combines a self-hosted OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible proxy with a reusable provider-rotation and resilience library. The main workflow is client request → proxy endpoint → rotating client → credential selection and limit checks → provider API → compatible response. Usage tracking, model metadata, and quota controls support that workflow. Some wiring is inferred from documented responsibilities and the tree; unsampled implementation details and uncertain links are omitted.
